title: OWASP WebGoat
description: A deliberately insecure Spring Boot application maintained by OWASP that teaches web application security through guided lessons: injection, broken authentication, XXE, insecure deserialization, JWT, path traversal and more. WebWolf, its companion, hosts files and receives mail and requests during the attacks.
question: Solve the WebGoat challenges listed for this lab and submit each flag WebGoat shows. The lessons themselves are tracked inside WebGoat.
